audience: billing, credentialing and research staff who check US healthcare providers in the NPI Registry

useCases.title: Look up a provider by NPI number
useCases.text: The AI reads the registry record for an exact 10-digit NPI: basic info, addresses, specialties (taxonomies), identifiers and other names.

useCases.title: Find doctors or nurses by name, specialty and place
useCases.text: The AI searches individual providers by name (with a * wildcard), specialty and location. It can then open a match by NPI to read its practice addresses.

useCases.title: Find clinics, hospitals or pharmacies by name
useCases.text: The AI searches organizations such as hospitals, group practices, pharmacies and labs by name, specialty and location.

useCases.title: Check a provider's specialty and practice address
useCases.text: The AI finds a provider by name and then reads the full record to compare specialties, addresses and identifiers with your own data.

useCases.title: Search the registry with mixed criteria
useCases.text: The AI searches across individual name, organization name, NPI, specialty and location in any combination, when the two simple searches are too narrow.
